Responsibilities

	Project Management
	Profitability
	Client/Customer Satisfaction
	Project Team Coordination.

	Diploma or Degree / NQF level 7

	Communication skills (verbal & written)
	Interpersonal skills
	Multi-tasking
	Administration skills

	Project management skills
	Ability to work in a face-paced environment
	Time management
	Process oriented.

	Strengthen internal controls and financial risk management frameworks.
	Collaborate with internal audit, risk management, and Compliance functions.
	Oversee financial risk exposures: credit, market, liquidity, operational, and regulatory.

	Lead and develop Finance teams across the Group (Treasury, accounting, FP&amp;A, Tax,
